# DevTools Online

> Free online developer tools — JSON formatter, Base64 decoder, UUID generator, and more

## Tools
- [Base64 Decoder & Encoder](https://YOUR_DOMAIN.example.com/tools/base64-decode.html): Decode and encode Base64 strings online. Free, fast, and privacy-friendly — all processing in your browser.
- [JSON Formatter & Beautifier](https://YOUR_DOMAIN.example.com/tools/json-formatter.html): Format, beautify, and validate JSON data online. Free, fast, and privacy-friendly — no data sent to servers.
- [UUID v4 Generator](https://YOUR_DOMAIN.example.com/tools/uuid-generator.html): Generate random UUID v4 identifiers instantly. Free, fast, and works offline — RFC 4122 compliant.
